data.name: Five Shifts at Zlata’s
data.detailed_description:
Zlata’s Dinner Restaurant welcomes you to a whole new kind of night shift — a true test of your nerves, instincts, and sanity.

You are the security mechanic of a recently reopened family restaurant where everything seems cozy and harmless at first glance. Friendly mascot-animatronics, warm lights, laughter, the clinking of dishes… But when night falls, everything changes.

Your task is simple — survive five shifts. Yet in this place, simple things quickly descend into madness. The animatronics begin to move on their own, the lights flicker, and the air in the storage room grows thin. You’ll have to monitor the cameras, restart the generator, balance the power, and make sure the mascots don’t get too close. Every sound, every shadow might be the last thing you hear or see before the lights go out again.

Discover what secrets this restaurant hides — and which sides of the story you’ve never seen before.
You can also…
Oh. Looks like the generator just went offline.

Now you’ll have to do more than keep the place safe — you’ll have to fight the darkness, the lack of air, and your own fears. Don’t let yourself lose your mind.

Experience the full horror of Zlata’s Dinner Restaurant — coming in 2026.
Welcome to the family. And try to make it to Friday.

data.short_description: Five Shifts at Zlata's is an atmospheric horror night-shift simulator where you play as a security mechanic in a family restaurant hiding dark secrets. Monitor cameras, manage power, restart the generator, and keep the animatronics-mascots away. Survive five shifts… if you can.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 3200 G/ Intel i3 - 8100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vega 8/ Intel UHD 630
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Recommended:

  • OS: 10/11

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon Vega 7/ GTX 1050ti / RX 560

content_descriptors.notes:
⸻

The game contains horror themes, tension, and stylized violence. Some scenes include implied injury and danger to the player character, but graphic violence or real-world gore are not shown. There are no sexual themes, no sexual violence, and no non-consensual content. The game focuses on psychological fear, suspense, and survival rather than explicit violence.
